blocked.name: Opal Palace
blocked.why: No EffectAmount for how many times a given commander was cast from the command zone; and 'if you spend this mana … it enters with counters' is a replacement, not a triggered ability, while whenSpent riders fire as triggers that can be responded to or countered.

blocked.name: Fact or Fiction
blocked.why: An opponent separates the revealed cards into two piles and you choose one — no pile decision.

blocked.name: Myr Battlesphere
blocked.why: 'You may tap X untapped Myr you control. If you do, +X/+0 and X damage' — no resolution-time 'tap any number of' choice whose count feeds an amount.

blocked.name: Forgotten Ancient
blocked.why: 'Move any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature onto other creatures' — no counter-moving effect, let alone a player-chosen distribution.

blocked.name: Windbrisk Heights
blocked.why: Hideaway (rule 702.75) is listed as unmodeled in AUTHORING §15.

blocked.name: Etali, Primal Storm
blocked.why: impulse-exile can exile each player's top card, but cast-now casts one card; 'cast any number of spells from among those cards' during resolution needs a repeated cast-now over the cards exiled this way.

blocked.name: Promise of Loyalty
blocked.why: Each player puts a vow counter on exactly one creature and sacrifices the rest (sacrifice-all-but keeps up to N, no counter), plus a counter-gated 'can't attack you or your planeswalkers' restriction tied to the caster.

blocked.name: Crib Swap
blocked.why: Kindred card type isn't modeled (AUTHORING §15: CardType has no 'kindred'), so a Kindred Instant — Shapeshifter with changeling can't be expressed.
